comparison.objective: Deliver one eye drop into a manikin’s right eye while holding the lower lid down and keeping the bottle tip off the face.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual eyelid displacement, bottle positioning, and single-drop dispensing without contact.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one drop reaches the target eye while the lid is drawn down and the tip avoids the face; excess drops or contact fail.
comparison.reason: This tests noncontact liquid dosing and soft-anatomy positioning, not controlled fracture and recovery of solid fragments.
